'''2018 European MPC Results Ralf Wachowiak DS I Want That Map''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Ralf Wachowiak]] at [[2018 European Match Play Championship]] (Results).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Ralf Wachowiak]]
* '''Event:''' [[2018 European Match Play Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|I Want That Map / And Now You'll Give It To Me|V8-D-iwantthatmap.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open I Want That Map Wachowiak DS 2018.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Results
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-european-match-play-championships/ PC list]
